topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I walked into the gallery, trailing wisps of morning mist. The light was just right, casting soft shadows that danced along the edges of my work. And there it was, a piece of me, transformed. Someone had tattooed it, a permanent etching upon skin. It startled me, this new form, but as I studied it, a different kind of clarity settled in. The lines, the colors—my vision, now a part of someone, forever. It seemed like an unexpected step in a journey I hadn’t known I was on. A strange sort of honor, perhaps. I turned to leave, the air still holding the whispers of what had been and the new life breathed into it.
